scope: Independent read-only review of the EXP-029 real-capture runner and builder; not evidence that models or a GPU run completed

evidence: build_runtime.remap_comp_input changes only comp DATA_DIR's expression to NTL_CAPTURE_DATA and checks restored AST equality.
worker copies original official train and the pinned blinded test into /kaggle/working/panel; main DATA is exported from the same NTL_CAPTURE_DATA.
Actual local 729-row CSV round-trips through both original readers with identical IDs/texts.
setup exports FAST_COMMIT=False after original discovery; model_args executes only the original cell12 prefix through command construction.
command waits for each child and rejects nonzero exit; the current comp commit receipt must exist and its manifest hash must match before main starts.
Stale original comp/meta/submission files and an occupied supervisor output directory are rejected.
The selected real run targets full 22-member/5-gate coverage and complete original ATLAS requests.
A normal zero-row ATLAS return provides the required event and is accepted by the hook template.
A thrown ATLAS call before any return still fails observer commit. Uncommitted files are retained for diagnosis; this is not accepted as complete coverage.
Returned partial ATLAS scores produce NEEDS_ADDITIONAL_ATLAS_SCORES and preserve a structured terminal cause.
A short-lived preflight child performs actual imports, including the original peft/torchao workaround, and an in-memory Parquet write/read.
It checks two T4 devices using tiny tensors and records CUDA/driver versions; parent supervisor/worker retains no CUDA model context.
The preflight runs before and after offline setup. These real dependency/GPU checks were not executed by this reviewer.
bounded_sha checks the absolute finalization deadline and signal state on every chunk and after reading.
Archive creation runs in a separate checked process group with a deadline reserving finalization time.
A final 28790-second boundary prevents a COMPLETE decision after that point, leaving 10 seconds for small terminal records.
No eligible comp group is distinguished as CONDITIONAL_COVERAGE_UNSATISFIED.
Missing planned member/gate coverage is CAPTURE_INVENTORY_MISMATCH; returned incomplete ATLAS is NEEDS_ADDITIONAL_ATLAS_SCORES.
The supervisor preserves these causes rather than collapsing them into generic CAPTURE_FAILED.

accepted_experiment_policy.required_coverage_condition: At least one eligible comp G_TE group must exist, and all predeclared attachment-dependent members/gates must actually contribute.
accepted_experiment_policy.all_singletons: Keep real outputs/caches and report target coverage not met; do not invent groups, delete required keys retrospectively, or call it an algorithm defect.
accepted_experiment_policy.excluded_member: tokattn_q35; the runner checks that a Q35 backbone is absent and does not count it in expected members.
accepted_experiment_policy.statistical_limit: The 17-label imbalanced panel and its source/training exposure do not establish robust improvement, 18-class balanced accuracy, clean OOF, or a leaderboard gain. Any later Sinkhorn comparison remains exploratory.

checks: Pinned original train and blinded panel SHA256; exact 729 rows; exploratory scope; fixed 28200/28800-second budgets.
Runtime file hashes and exact declared file inventory are checked before work and again at completion.
Plan hash is retained in context and checked unchanged at completion.
CPU manifest must be PASS and its 31 attachment bindings exactly equal the plan.
Every listed mounted file must exist at the same path with the same size.
Files <=16MiB are rehashed on the GPU runtime; larger files rely on the CPU full hash plus same immutable attachment versions and GPU path/size checks.
The source official train path is selected only from CPU-manifest entries with the fixed original train hash.
Original training bytes and blinded test bytes are copied into one new panel directory, then rehashed.
Test requires only id/text, unique 729 IDs and nonblank text; truth/prompt sidecar is not consumed.
SMOKE, TINY, FAKE_TEST, POOL and NTL_DATA environment overrides are cleared.
Original cell2 discovery runs in a checked child; only offline pip is used, now with check=True.
Main/comp load the same staged panel; only comp's directory binding and main's directory argument differ from historical paths.
Comp must exit zero and print exactly one matching run/component commit hash before main.
Original cell12 creates the model specifications and flags. Only executable/script path and capped ATLAS budget are changed by the runner.
Both component manifests are read with the external printed hashes, expected IDs/texts/18-label order and matching context contents/hash.
Declared 16/22 member coverage and 5 family gates are checked without removing missing keys.
CPU replay validates captured arithmetic; final actual Parquet IDs/models must equal the cached typography argmax.
No sidecar truth is loaded and no accuracy or parameter search runs in the GPU worker.

immutable_binding_limit.required_external_condition: Root must bind the actual saved GPU kernel's 31 original attachment versions and requested image to the CPU preflight readback; matching plan declarations alone are not platform proof.
immutable_binding_limit.not_claimed: The GPU stage does not independently detect a same-size byte rewrite of a >16MiB mount if the provider's immutable-version guarantee is violated.
immutable_binding_limit.historical_limit: These newly pinned attachment bytes need not equal the historical EXP-004 scorer's bytes; source compatibility is not historical checkpoint authentication.

guard_assessment.process_ownership: The supervisor creates one worker session/process group. Setup, preflight and model children inherit it. Failure, signal and work/RSS timeout converge through finally to TERM then KILL of that owned group, including after the leader exits.
guard_assessment.archive_ownership: Archive has a separate child group and is stopped on archive timeout/failure.
guard_assessment.main_budget: Original relative ATLAS budget is capped to remaining global work minus120 seconds; less than180 seconds fails before main. Original main T0 is not shifted.
guard_assessment.finalization: Chunked hashes and the terminal decision obey the absolute finalization boundary; final small records use the reserved last10 seconds.
guard_assessment.os_level_limit: Reviewer tests mock Linux group signals on Windows. They prove call/control-flow behavior, not actual Linux scheduler/driver teardown.

real_cell12_prefix_builds_16_member_plan_with_original_fixed_parameters

limits: Process-group calls were mocked on Windows; this does not prove Linux OS-level termination behavior.

verification.author_reported_checks: Runtime author separately reported12 no-GPU checks including a real exit7 child/log, receipt failures, budget boundary and finalization checks. This report distinguishes that author evidence from the reviewer's own probes.

remaining_acceptance_conditions: Complete and verify the actual CPU preflight result, then bind its manifest hash into the real payload.
Root must read back actual saved GPU attachment versions, privacy, offline flags and image, rather than treating requested metadata as proof.
The runtime must pass its real import/Parquet/T4 preflight and actual checkpoint loading; those remain unrun in this review.
Only the actual terminal outputs, component receipts, archived bytes, complete coverage and replay can establish capture completion.
